messages:
alex: Heads up — CI turned red on the py38 matrix after the last lockfile update (PR #4321). Fail is during install, looks like a new transitive requires Python>=3.11.

ci-bot: CI failed: linux/pytest-py38 (job id: 9843) — see logs: https://ci.internal/9843 

alex: Error snippet from the failing job:
```
ERROR: Package 'fastcrypto' requires a different Python: 3.11+.
The wheel for fastcrypto-1.0.0-cp311-... is present but no cp38 wheel.
```

sasha: hmm — which dependency pulled in fastcrypto? I can run pipdeptree against the lockfile. @alex can you paste the lockfile diff or the Dependabot commit?

alex: dependabot bumped cryptography -> 41.0.0 and that pulled in fastcrypto (transitive for our pyopenssl wrapper). Diff (excerpt):
```diff
- cryptography = "^40.0.0"
+ cryptography = "^41.0.0"
```

kevin: That makes sense. IIRC cryptography 41 dropped py38 wheels / started requiring py311 for prebuilt wheels for manylinux. We should either pin to 40.x for py38 CI or skip py38 matrix (but we still support py38 for a bit).

maria: quick triage plan: 1) revert the lock bump in the PR that deps updated 2) run a bisect on the lockfile to confirm cryptography is the culprit 3) if confirmed, publish a patch pin in pyproject for now. Who can take the bisect?

sasha: I'll do the bisect now. Running locally: `git checkout master && git bisect start --revs=origin/main HEAD` then iterate by swapping lockfiles from the dependabot commits. If anyone has a faster idea (pipdeptree on the two lockfiles might be quicker).

kevin: Another quick check: you can create a py38 venv and `pip install -r <requirements-from-lock>` and grep for fastcrypto. That will prove missing wheel. I can do that if sasha is busy.

sasha: Update — pipdeptree shows cryptography 41 -> fastcrypto 1.0.0. Confirmed reproducer in a py38 venv: `pip install cryptography==41.0.0` fails with the same error (no cp38 wheel).

alex: Cool, thanks. Can we pin cryptography back to 40.* in pyproject.toml and regenerate lock? I'll open a small PR to pin only for the pyproject dependency section so future updates don't auto-upgrade.

maria: +1. Also add a CI guard: in our test matrix add a step that checks `python_requires`/wheel-compatibility for each dependency in the lockfile (small script). That would catch this earlier. File a follow-up issue for the guard.

kevin: PR idea: add `[[tool.poetry.extras]]`? Nah. Simpler: in the PR body, mention the cause and add a temporary pin with a TODO to remove once we drop py38 support.

alex: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4330 — pins cryptography to 40.* in pyproject and regenerates poetry.lock. Triggering CI now.

ci-bot: Re-run queued: linux/pytest-py38 (job id: 9843) triggered by alex.

sasha: Rerun passed on my dev run. Hoping CI green. If it fails again, we'll bisect the lockfile commits more strictly. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
